docs.summary:
Called each frame right before `Paper.BeginFrame`. Sets Paper's logical resolution to the window's logical size (OS points) and `DisplayFramebufferScale` to [`ContentScale`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Window~ContentScale). Quill's `TransformPoint` multiplies every vertex by `DisplayFramebufferScale`, so vertices span `[0, winSize × cs]` = `[0, fbSize]`, exactly matching the orthographic projection set up by [`UpdateProjection`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.GUI.PaperRenderer~UpdateProjection).

A widget declared `Width(100)` occupies 100 logical points = 100 physical pixels at 1× DPI and 200 physical pixels at 2× (Retina) DPI the same physical size on screen regardless of display density, with higher pixel quality on HiDPI displays.
Whether the main Paper should see the pointer this frame. Disabled while the cursor is locked, so the pinned pointer can't hover UI the user cannot see or aim at.
Reset the fixed-update accumulator. Call when entering play mode to prevent a burst.
Closes the window. In the editor this closes the editor itself, so gameplay code uses [`Quit`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Application~Quit).
